effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, if you have a Tamer with the [Zaxon] trait, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of their Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects and gets -6000 DP.
[On Deletion] Place this card face up as the bottom security card.
